patch.value: Validate contributed scalar flag values before extension handler dispatch

A harmless echo fixture declares type bool but --enabled not-a-boolean reaches its handler as a string. Coercion preserves invalid input for later validation, yet current dynamic dispatch validates only allowed/required/disabled option keys. Establish an explicit compatible scalar-validation contract for extension authors.

Define compatibility for invalid number/boolean tokens and optional no-value presence; Apply shared SDK-owned scalar validation before handler invocation where opted in or required by the supported contract; Preserve canonical switch positional behavior and legacy bool grammar; Independently assert malformed value refusals and valid coercion/default/list cases through public CLI/SDK
